propositions: get_parent_map, get_comment_map, and get_issuelinks_map lack multi-page test coverage; existing tests only exercise single-page responses with isLast:true

Cloud's three whole-project readers paginate via opaque cursor (nextPageToken + isLast flag) and terminate on either isLast:true or null/absent nextPageToken, with no assertion that the cursor advances, pages are fetched, or a repeated token stops

A repeated/identical cursor token causes the readers to spin forever in an unbounded request loop since neither break condition fires; fail-open exception handling converts this into silent partial maps
AST guard for adapters/jira/*.py was added to prevent unpaginated whole-project readers; DC's equivalent guard scans only DC transport, leaving this seam open on Cloud until now
